reason: The unfired blanks appear intended for the furnace, and firing them may produce a firm floor for the liner.
expectation: I expect the blanks to be heated into stronger floor pieces, though they may need further assembly.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric might provide padding, but the blanks seem like the first step toward a solid floor.

effect: The fired blocks can serve as non-pressure paving, so I can use them to prepare the growing bay floor.
reaction: The distinction between paving and pressure containment makes physical sense.
reason: Place the ceramic blocks in the cleared bay to make the floor for the liner.
expectation: I expect the blocks to form a paved floor, perhaps still needing a protective covering.

alternatives.reason: The felt and fabric may make that covering, but the paving seems useful first.

effect: The level floor is ready to support the liner without bridging hollows; the felt and fabric are the only available combination.
reaction: Adjusting the block bedding is a satisfying, practical detail.
reason: Combine the felt and fabric, likely to make a protective layer for the liner.
expectation: I expect a padded covering for the floor, though its exact use is uncertain.

effect: The padded underlay will protect the pressure skin from ceramic edges, so it belongs on the level floor.
reaction: The protective layer is a sensible follow-through on the paving.
reason: Place the underlay on the floor; it's the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect a cushioned floor ready for the pressure envelope.

effect: The protected floor completes the first goal and is ready for the pressure envelope.
reaction: The separate load-bearing and protective layers make sense.
reason: Place the envelope on the prepared floor; it is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the envelope to unfold into a room, though it may still need air and lighting.

effect: The sealed enclosure is in place, with imported seals containing the air and local blocks supporting its weight.
reaction: The distinction between the enclosure and its supporting floor is clear.
reason: Supply breathing gas to the sealed room; it's the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the room to be pressurized and breathable, though it will still need lighting.

effect: The enclosure is pressurized and has passed its leak check; it now needs lighting.
reaction: Stepping into the inflated room makes the construction feel tangible.
reason: Install the grow-light rails to illuminate the room; it is the only offered gameplay action.
expectation: I expect the rails to provide growing light, though they may need a power connection.

effect: The service spine supplies circulation and heat, and the lamps complete the room using the existing array; both chapter goals are complete.
reaction: The explanation of the power and service connections makes the finished room feel plausible.

mostWorthwhile.text: Pressurizing the enclosure was the most worthwhile moment: stepping into the room made the layered construction feel tangible.

leastWorthwhile.text: The separate underlay preparation and placement felt a little repetitive, although their protective purpose was clear.

surprise.text: I appreciated the distinction between locally fired blocks carrying weight and the imported envelope and seals containing pressure.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt notably arbitrary; even the padding had a clear purpose in protecting the liner from ceramic edges.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the practical construction details and the finished growing room make me curious about what comes next, despite the largely linear choices.
